Definition: a gem (perhaps used for scratching other substances), probably the sapphire
BiblicalUsage: The Old Testament word çappîyr means a gem, probably the sapphire. It appears 11 times, and the passages that use it — Exodus and Ezekiel among them — show it in its natural setting. Read them together and the meaning settles itself.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe God chose çappîyr on purpose. A gem, probably the sapphire is not an accident of language; it is the way He says what He means.
Sources: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890), via OpenScriptures Strong's Dictionary (CC BY-SA)
